note: Ostend: the town rebuilt after the siege of 1601-04, an earthen bastioned enceinte; the three gates are those named for the later 17th c. (inventory 140010). Traced from the Ferraris map (1777) along the main rampart; the outworks and the eastern harbour forts are not traced.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Oostende' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140010)
